stem: What role did the Supreme Court play in this declaration?

options.label: A
options.text: The court ruled Florida's use of butterfly ballots violated the Equal Protection Clause.

options.label: B
options.text: The court ruled on the constitutionality of the vote recount in Florida.

options.label: C
options.text: The court determined that campaign contributions are forms of free speech.

options.label: D
options.text: The court ruled that requiring literacy tests to vote was unconstitutional.
